features.name: Scenario navigation list
features.description: Left-hand ListBox lets the user switch between the two DPI scaling scenarios. Selecting an item loads that scenario's page on the right.
expected_behaviour: A list with exactly two items: '1) Load images for different scales' and '2) Override default scaling of UI elements'.
Selecting an item navigates the content frame to the corresponding scenario page.

features.area: Scenario 1 - Load images for different scales
features.name: Current scale and logical DPI readout
features.description: Scenario 1 displays the current display scale factor and the logical DPI derived from it.
expected_behaviour: Shows 'Current scale:' with the live scale percentage (e.g. 150%).
Shows 'Logical DPI for this scale:' with the matching DPI value (e.g. 144 DPI).

features.area: Scenario 1 - Load images for different scales
features.name: Not scaling aware image demo
features.description: Shows an image loaded without multiple scale assets to demonstrate non-scaling-aware behaviour.
expected_behaviour: A projector image is shown beside the 'Not scaling aware (not recommended)' label.
Explanatory text notes the asset is distorted at scales other than 100%.

features.area: Scenario 1 - Load images for different scales
features.name: Scaled packaged assets demo
features.description: Shows a packaged image whose correct scale variant (e.g. 1.8x) is auto-selected by the framework based on current DPI.
expected_behaviour: A projector image with a scale badge (e.g. '1.8x') beside the 'Scaled packaged assets' label.
Explanatory text describes the image.scale-100/140/180 naming convention.

features.area: Scenario 1 - Load images for different scales
features.name: Vector graphics (XAML path) demo
features.description: Shows a vector image encoded directly in XAML markup that resizes automatically with scale.
expected_behaviour: A projector graphic rendered from XAML path data beside the 'Vector Graphics Using XAML Path' label.

features.area: Scenario 1 - Load images for different scales
features.name: Scaled external assets demo
features.description: Loads a scale-appropriate asset from an external/URL source and reports the URL used.
expected_behaviour: A 'Scaled external assets' section with a projector image and a status/URL readout.

features.area: Scenario 2 - Override default scaling of UI elements
features.name: Resolution / scaling header readout
features.description: Scenario 2 shows a header describing the current overriding-scaling state (ResolutionTextBlock).
expected_behaviour: An 'Overriding scaling' header / resolution readout is shown at the top of the scenario.

features.area: Scenario 2 - Override default scaling of UI elements
features.name: Default scaling UI element measurements
features.description: Shows a UI element under default scaling with its relative (view) px, physical (raw) px, and layout text size.
expected_behaviour: DefaultRelativePx shows a 'view px' value (e.g. 100.0 view px).
DefaultPhysicalPx shows a 'raw px' value (e.g. 150 raw px).
DefaultLayoutText shows the default point size (e.g. 20pt).

features.area: Scenario 2 - Override default scaling of UI elements
features.name: Override scaling UI element measurements
features.description: Shows the same UI element with an overridden (RasterizationScale) scale, reporting relative px, physical px, and layout text size.
expected_behaviour: OverrideRelativePx shows a reduced 'view px' value (e.g. 66.7 view px).
OverridePhysicalPx shows a 'raw px' value (e.g. 100 raw px).
OverrideLayoutText shows the overridden point size (e.g. 13pt).
